title: Script Mapper
subtitle: Unicode & JSON Support
description: Map Latin keystrokes to Devanagari and Tirhuta characters with interactive composition and Unicode references.
architecture: Engineered around modular script mapping components, executing client-side Unicode transformations and local storage persistence.
vision: Provide an accessible multi-script mapping, composition, and testing utility for Indic scripts like Devanagari and Tirhuta.
